notes.title: Hoops Madness OFFICIAL RELEASE! LEAVING EARLY ACCESS!!!
notes.content:
Full Cross-Platform Support, Usability, Networking/Multiplayer, & Content Updates & Improvements. 

Hey Hoopers! The Hoops Madness Team has been hard at work with a number of updates while we prepare for Full Release. We're excited to announce a major update to increase the competition, its social aspects, and make shooting hoops feel even better. [b]BUT[/b] we are REALLY excited to announce that we are transitioning out of Early Access!!! Are you ready to Play, Connect, & Compete?!

This update is [b]PACKED [/b]with usability improvements, networking enhancements, & content updates so that the only thing standing in your way are your competitors. ːsteamhappyː

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Full Cross-Platform Support:[/b] Added in cross-play between all the major headsets (we will be cross-play compliant with the Quest once we are live on Oculus App Lab!) & VR platforms (Steam, Oculus Rift, & Viveport). The home “Court” just became even bigger & more expansive!
[*] [b]SteamVR support for Quest 1 & Quest 2 via the link cable & experimental support for Windows Mixed Reality. More competition = More fun![/b] 
[*] [b]New slimmed down ball racks & ball spawning feature:[/b] You will always have a ball to shoot with and won’t need to fight over them with your competitors. You also won't need to wait for balls to respawn on the ball rack! ːsteamhappyː
[*] [b]Player Hand IK (inverse kinematics) Update:[/b] More efficient and hand poses look good when the ball is equipped to the hand.
[*] [b]All New Lighting:[/b] Gettin' the mood right!
[*] [b]New & Clearer Audio Mix:[/b] Players can now hear the balls hitting the court floor and bouncing off of the backboard.
[*] [b]Added doors in the Stadium Scene:[/b] Provides a more polished and cohesive look.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Addressed latency ball offset issue where balls would float outside of your hands. Now nothing stands in your way of being able to aim and shoot with ease! 
[*] Player Login update fixes:
[list]
[*]Enables cross-platform functionality to operate properly. 
[*]“Failed to Login” message no longer displays on the Player Setup Board after you have logged in successfully (if your prior attempt was incorrect).
[/list]
[*] Removed “flickering” artifacts in the corners of the Practice Facility. The Practice Facility now features a visually cohesive court environment.
[*] Addressed an issue with the Leaderboards. Scores now populate automatically so you always know where you stand competitively.
[*] Player hands don't stick anymore!
[*] Around the World game mode: Addressed an issue with the ball rack position within the teleportation zone position when using a stationary boundary.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

[list]
[*] If you start the game with your controllers disabled, you will most likely need to restart the game with your controllers enabled.
[*] Monthly Tournament Leaderboard might not display automatically in the Practice Facility. Clicking on the Monthly Tournament button though will bring up the correct Leaderboard.
[/list]

The Hoops Madness Team can be reached directly at hoops.madness@vrstudios.com with any feedback you might have. We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: WIN $100 STEAM CREDIT! Hoops Madness October Tournament Ending on October 31st
notes.content:
Hey Hoopers! Just a reminder that our October prize-based tournament will be ending after this week so GET IN THE GAME and compete to win those prizes. You still have time to *BRING IT* in the [b]Shootout [/b]game mode in Hoops Madness to determine who will ultimately be victorious.

[u]As a reminder from our previous announcement:[/u]

Compete against others to rack up the highest scores in [b]Shootout[/b] to determine who the top Shootout Hoopers are. We will award prizes to the top 3 players at the end of October, so get in the game and put those shooting skills to the test. 

[b][u]If you don't already own the game,[/u][/b] get it now on Early Access for 50% off. So, it pays to get in on Hoops Madness now while the game is still featuring Early Access pricing.

And you can compete on the headset of your choice as we offer support for Vive, Vive Pro, Rift, Rift S, and the Index. You can even use your Quest with the link cable and a PC to turn your Quest into a Rift to participate as well.

Now onto the fun & important stuff! Here's what players will win:

[list]
[*] 1st Place - $100 Steam Gift Card & one free copy of Hoops Madness to give to a friend.
[*] 2nd Place - $50 Steam Gift Card & one free copy of Hoops Madness to give to a friend.
[*] 3rd Place - $25 Steam Gift Card & one free copy of Hoops Madness to give to a friend.
[/list]
 
You will need to sign up for an account in the game (and verify that account) in order to compete in the tournament and enable other cool things like the ability to track your scores and rank your performance on global leaderboards.

STAY TUNED for more tournaments and even [b]BIGGER[/b] prizes coming!!!

notes.title: 2020's Been Hard Enough. Makin' Things Easier for You! New Account Updates
notes.content:
Forget your password while logging back into your account? No problem! We got ya covered! We have implemented a “Forgot PW” button in-game. Clicking the button in-game will open a browser and redirect you to https://app.vrstudios.com/forgot/password.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38596510/c124ee6f735fcd54db5967f1322474789565ebad.png[/img]

We also set up a “Resend Verification” button in-game and notification at the bottom of the Player Setup chalkboard that will inform you if your account hasn't been verified yet. This will only be displayed to you when you are logged in, but not with a verified account. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38596510/3b4577f4e9a9044628ebc77b1beba467be8bfd22.png[/img]

We also fixed a bug in which choosing "Solo Play" would set the Player Roster 'Host Name' as empty.

The Hoops Madness Team can be reached directly at hoops.madness@vrstudios.com with any feedback you might have. We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Compete Against the Hoop Madness Developers - THIS FRIDAY (10/23/20) @ 1pm PDT
notes.content:
Hey Hoopers! Show us what ya got by taking on the developers of Hoops Madness. This challenge and social hour will be taking place [b]THIS FRIDAY (10/23/20) from 1-2pm PDT[/b]. 

Every time you beat a Hoops Madness developer in a challenge, you'll receive a free copy of the game to gift to a friend. Let's hoop it up through several game modes to see who has the right stuff!

So it will be important to sign up for an account in the game (and verify that account), if you haven't already, in order to compete against us and enable other cool things like the ability to track your scores and rank your performance on global leaderboards.

You can compete on the headset of your choice with cross-play on Steam as we offer support for Vive, Vive Pro, Rift, Rift S, and the Index. You can even use your Quest with the link cable and a PC to turn your Quest into a Rift to participate as well.

[b]BUT THERE'S MORE!!![/b] ːsteamhappyː

This is also a GREAT time to socialize with the game makers. We'd love to also chat with you, answer your questions, and hear what you like about the game and what things you'd like to see in the game.

notes.title: We've Been Listening to You! Calling all Valve Index Players!
notes.content:
Hey Hoopers! We’ve been listening to you and are excited to now offer support for the Valve Index to further heat up the competition. Are you ready to Play, Connect, & Compete?!

We have been listening to YOU, the Community, that a number of you want to play the game but needed us to provide support for your HMD of choice – the Valve Index. Well, we have made that happen and we think playing with the Knuckles Controller feels great. But we’d love to hear from you!

We have also been making additional updates to the game.


[h1]Additional Updates:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Particle Effects Update:[/b] Blazin' hotter than ever! ːsteamhappyː
[*] [b]Dominion Game Mode Update:[/b] Added a notification to the Dominion game mode to prevent confusion when players have the same or similar jersey colors. So, you'll always know when you control the hoop! 
[*] [b]Player Setup Board Update:[/b] Added an outline to the player color options to make the black color easier to see
[*] Increased the player name text on the account panel for easier viewing
[*] Updated the player jerseys. Gotta look sharp!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Find Match tooltip displays when a game is in progress
[*] Logging in now sets your account info based on account settings, rather than player preferences
[*] Fixed a bug where scores were doubling up on the Tournament Banners
[*] Fixed login bugs where you couldn't update the jersey if logged in as a Guest. Also if no account is available, it should once again properly set you as Guest by default
[/list]

STAY TUNED for some EXCITING announcements coming real soon!

The Hoops Madness Team can be reached directly at hoops.madness@vrstudios.com with any feedback you might have. We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Can You Hear Me? Voice Chat is now LIVE!!!
notes.content:
Hey Hoopers! We're excited to announce an update to increase the competition and its social aspects. Are you ready to Play, Connect, & Compete?!

The Hoops Madness Team has been hard at work with a number of updates while we have been in Early Access. Regular Updates are forthcoming, [b]BUT[/b] we are excited to announce these two major updates as well as some bug fixes.

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]In-game Voice Chat:[/b] Added in-game voice chat to increase social engagement during competition. Feel free to trash talk your buddies as you compete to see who takes MVP Honors!
[*] [b]Rift/Rift S Support in Steam:[/b] Added in support for the Rift & Rift S (and Touch Controllers) on Steam. More competition = More fun!
[*] [b]New music track:[/b] Updated the game with a brand new funky music track to really bring out the vibe of the game and get your fists pumping ːsteamhappyː
[*] [b]Matchmaking Update:[/b] Matchmaking has been updated with increased clarity for the following:
[list]
[*] Hosting Games
[*] Finding Games
[*] High Player Count Warning
[*] Logged Out Warning
[/list]
[*] [b]Player Color's Update:[/b] Enhanced jersey colors for better player understanding
[*] [b]Post Processing Updates:[/b] Added Bloom and Color Grading
[*] [b]Anti-Cheat Feature:[/b] NO DUNKING! - Added in a prevention for players using 3rd party software to offset their position to score baskets super easily
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where hitting a Checkpoint in the Hoop Derby game mode would rotate players 45-90 degrees
[*] Changed player initial load-in position to half court, facing the "main" direction
[*] Addressed issue where the matches' Host name was incorrect in the "Find Match" tooltip in the Team Room
[*] Fixed a bug where the ranking on the players HUD was not correct to their actual ranking in the game
[*] Matchmaker auto re-connection is now working properly
[*] Addressed various issues with the backboards in the Dominion game mode
[/list]

The Hoops Madness Team can be reached directly at hoops.madness@vrstudios.com with any feedback you might have. We look forward to hearing from you!
